text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I bet Fuji Kiseki's gonna win today since
she did
so well at the NHK Mile Cup!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't be so sure. Biko Pegasus and
Hishi
Akebono are running too, and
they're really
strong competitors.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That's true. The stands are usually filled
with
cheering, but it's so tense today...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Various conversations fill the racecourse
as
everyone waits for the race to begin.
Meanwhile,
in the waiting room...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Phew! I'm feeling a little nervous.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hi, Fuji! I hope we can have a good race
today!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Biko! Thanks for coming by. I'm sure it'll
be a
great one.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You're very welcome! You know what
they say.
Manners make heroes!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Akebono, you came too! It feels so
lively in
here now!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Nice to see you, Fuji. Come on,
Biko, it's
time to do our pre-race ritual!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yup! This is a big race, so we made a
promise to
hype each other up!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I know! You should do it with us too,
Fuji! It'll be
real fun!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's a great idea since we'll be
competing
against each other today!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Thanks, you two. I don't feel so
nervous
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Right! Let's make today a race to
remember!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The three of them put their hands
together in a
huddle and their energetic
chant fills the room,
kicking off the Mile
Championship!
